newsitem.title: CHINA: China says zinc's fall not enough to cover losses.
newsitem.headline: China says zinc's fall not enough to cover losses.

text.p: Sharp falls in zinc prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Tuesday were not enough to wipe out losses faced by Chinese smelters that still hold short positions, a Chinese metals industry official said on Wednesday.
"We still need to wait, the drop is not enough," the official of China National Nonferrous Metals Corp's (CNNC) import and export company said.
"We must see how much the difference is between the current price and the price at which we sold," the official said.
"If the difference is still very big, it is difficult to offset all the short positions," he said by telephone from Beijing.
Chinese smelters sold forward around 200,000 to 250,000 tonnes at $1,100 per tonne, other CNNC officials have said.
The official said China's zinc production capacity was enough to cover the short positions -- said by market sources to fall due in mid-September.
